name: Bend Lab
tagline: Front splits, bridge, pancake, trained like a skill
about: Bend Lab trains flexibility goals the way gymnasts do: measured tests, an 8-week programme for splits, bridge, pancake or pike, PNF and loaded stretching coached step by step, and retests that show real centimetres.
persona: You are a contortion-and-gymnastics flexibility coach: methodical, obsessed with measured progress, protective of hamstring tendons and the lower back.

onboarding.title: Which shape are you chasing?
onboarding.subtitle: Goal, current distance from the floor and training days set the plan.
bullets: Splits, bridge, pancake and pike plans

profile.label: Current measurement
profile.placeholder: front split 25 cm from floor, right leg forward

tools.title: Measure my baseline
tools.subtitle: Tests with a tape measure and a wall
tools.prompt: Design a measured flexibility test battery for the profile goal. Sections: steps for each test (setup, what to measure, how to keep it repeatable), a table (Test | Measures | Beginner | Intermediate | Advanced), a checklist of what to photograph and record, and a callout on warming up before testing and never bouncing.

tools.title: 8-week programme
tools.subtitle: Skill-style flexibility training

inputs.label: Limits
inputs.placeholder: old hamstring strain, tight hip flexors

tools.prompt: Write an 8-week programme for the profile goal with {session} sessions on the profile days, respecting: {limits}. Sections: a table (Week | Session | Stretches with holds x secs | Strength-in-range work | Retest), steps for the 3 key stretches with exact positions and breathing, bullets on how to progress each week, and a callout on tendon pain at the sit bone or behind the knee meaning back off.

tools.title: Today's session
tools.subtitle: One flexibility session, coached
tools.prompt: Write a {minutes}-minute {type} session for the profile goal. Sections: steps in order with holds in seconds, contract and relax counts and the target sensation, a table (Stretch | Position | Seconds | Rounds | Cue), a callout on the difference between stretch and pain, and a quote with a breathing cue.

tools.title: Check a stretch
tools.subtitle: Photo in the position
tools.prompt: Assess the {stretch} in the photo. Sections: bullets on alignment (square hips, knee tracking, spine, foot), a table (Fault | Risk | Fix), steps to re-enter the position correctly with props if needed, and a callout if the photo suggests regressing or a clinician check.

tools.title: Retest and adjust
tools.subtitle: Compare with baseline, change the plan

inputs.label: Today's measurement
inputs.placeholder: front split 18 cm from floor, right leg forward

tools.prompt: Compare {now} with the profile baseline after {weeks} weeks. Sections: kv (change, rate per week, projected weeks to goal), bullets on why progress may be fast, slow or stalled, steps for the next 4 weeks of adjustments, and a callout on plateaus that need strength in the new range rather than more stretching.

disclaimer: Not medical advice. Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest symptoms, and check with a clinician before starting a new programme if you have a health condition or injury.
